# Now playing triggers

![Adding a trigger: on the Actions page, click + Trigger and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-trigger-picker.png)

## Song changed

Runs when a new song starts in your music player or on Spotify. Great for a "Now playing: …" message in chat. Tick "Watch what plays" on the Music page first.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Player** | Only react to one player: type part of its name, like spotify or vlc. Leave it empty to react to every player. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The song's name, like "Never Gonna Give You Up" |
| `%artist%` | Who sings or plays it, like "Rick Astley" (several artists are joined with commas) |
| `%album%` | The album the song is on (empty when the player does not say) |
| `%player%` | The player it plays in, like Spotify, VLC or Firefox |
| `%artUrl%` | A link to the cover picture, when the player gives one |
| `%duration%` | How long the song is, in seconds (0 when unknown) |
| `%durationText%` | How long the song is, written like 3:45 |
| `%link%` | A web link to the song (Spotify songs only) |
| `%source%` | "system" for a player on this computer, "spotify" for your Spotify account |
| `%nowPlaying.title%` | The same values again with nowPlaying. in front, so the same message works with the "Get now playing" step |

<small>Type id: `nowplaying.songChanged`</small>
